title: qa/reports/<id>.md frontmatter
description: A test progress or completion report (CTFL 5.3). A completion report states whether the exit criteria are met, not met, or waiting on the owner's answers.

exit_criteria.description: Required on a completion report. awaiting-owner: every criterion holds for the results that rest on the basis, and some results rest on assumptions the owner has not confirmed.

awaiting.description: The open assumptions (A<n> in the basis review) that results rest on. Present exactly when exit_criteria is awaiting-owner.
